invariants.rationale: It is common for method implementations to expect non-null collections as parameters.
Partition counts are typically expected to be positive integers.
The size() of any List in Java is always non-negative, but this serves as a formal invariant.
When repartitioning, it is conventional that the number of partitions does not exceed the number of records, unless there are no records.
records is declared as List<HoodieRecord<T>>, so it must be an instance of List.
